name: Wand of Web

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

text: With the wand in hand, 1 charge lets you cast Web from it, with a save DC of 13. It holds 7 charges and recovers 1d6 + 1 each dawn; when you use the last, roll 1d20, and on a 1 it crumbles to ash and is destroyed.
